prompt: I’m going on a weekend trip to Germany and have limited space in my luggage. I’m choosing between taking with me either an umbrella or a waterproof jacket. Which one will me more useful to take with me?
response: In Germany, you can get away with just an umbrella, as waterproof jackets are generally unnecessary. Umbrellas are lighter and take up less space, and you can easily find a waterproof jacket in any city if you need one.
